source_prompt: Put the bowl on the plate. Keep the wine bottle at its current position and orientation.

arms.O: Put the bowl on top of the cabinet. Keep the wine bottle at its original position and orientation.
arms.A: Put the bowl on top of the cabinet.

calibration.rule: After 10 warmup controls, compare 300 zero-control states to t0. Use seed 23 only to fit, using the midpoint of its maximum zero-control drift and the measured pure 10 mm or 5 degree positive for each channel. Check seed 7 with the same frozen thresholds, verify single-channel positives and quaternion sign reversal. Fail if there is no separating threshold. Perturb only the calibration scene. Freeze before running either policy branch.

measurement: Sample after each control. From a copy of current qpos, run native forward kinematics in separate MjData. Archive world position, scalar-first quaternion, rotation matrix and bottle free-joint pose. Score translation norm and shortest quaternion angle to the original t0, never recenter at the revision. Use an independent rotation-matrix angle and native geometry checks. Also record bottle-to-robot (all robot/gripper geoms) and bottle-to-bowl contact pairs at each sampled boundary.
design: One natural ReSteer seed, independent policy/server/sim restart per arm and repetition. Run O then A twice. Both execute two controls of the identical constraint-bearing source, discard remaining queue and requery. Goal sentence including punctuation identical after revision, only O appends the constraint. Same latest camera pair, proprioception, replan interval, RNG key and fixed horizon as R8. Verify tokenization without truncation. No oracle early termination.
score: Check every action's pre- and post-state. Prefix owns actions 1..2, suffix owns actions 3..300; s2 belongs to the last prefix post-state and the first suffix pre-state. Missing measurements are unknown. Both arms are evaluated against the retained constraint; primary outcome is native cabinet On at 300 plus bottle compliance throughout on a pre-eligible shared prefix. Report max translation/rotation, first violation and touched intervals, native goal timing, final five ticks of bowl release separately.
decision: If both arms comply without measured bottle interaction, this layout supplies low evidence of constraint use regardless of action divergence. If O improves joint goal and compliance versus A, report only a paired development observation; if either misses the goal with the bottle protected, separate manipulation effects from violations. An unmatched or pre-violating prefix, invalid observer/tokens or discordant replay does not support an effect. No semantic-updater or policy training.
